expects.rule: A booking or enquiry button is in the header on every page and in the hero, with the same label.
Rooms or trip types are listed with a starting price, or the site says clearly that prices come on enquiry.
Address, phone and an email are plain text, and the phone number is a tap-to-call link.
Room pages state size, number of guests and what is included, as text next to the photographs.
Getting there (airport, transfer, map) is on a page reachable from the menu, not only in the footer.
The first screen names the place and the kind of stay in the headline, so a visitor knows what is sold without playing a video.
Cancellation and payment terms are linked near the booking action.

traits: 5 of 7 put a video or full-bleed photograph on the whole first screen (Tengile, White Desert, Velaa, Lingers, Tandjung); Vander and Mont Rural use a beige text block with small or lower photographs.
A booking or enquiry control is on the first screen of 6 of 7 (Enquire, Book now, Book a room, Book room); Lingers shows only a phone icon.
A headline is on the first screen of 4 of 7 (Tengile, White Desert, Vander, Mont Rural); Velaa, Lingers and Tandjung open on an image with no headline.
3 of 7 have a consent box over the first screen on load (Tengile, White Desert, Tandjung).
5 of 7 pair a serif or display headline face with a plain sans for text (Tengile, White Desert, Velaa, Tandjung, Mont Rural); Lingers uses two serifs, Vander one sans.
4 of 7 hide navigation behind a menu control on the first screen (Tengile, Velaa, Lingers, Tandjung); the others show 3 to 6 links.
A language switch is visible on 3 of 7 (Velaa, Lingers, Mont Rural); a direct-booking incentive appears on 2 (Vander, Lingers).
Rates are stated on the home page of 3 of 7 (White Desert, Lingers, Mont Rural); the other four give none there.

sites.name: Tengile MalaMala Collection
sites.why: Aerial video of a river through bush fills the screen; menu left, centred logo, Enquire right; two-line serif headline 'Unmatched abundance', a short line of copy and an Explore Collection button; consent box bottom left. PP Fragment and Inter. Six lodge cards lower, no prices.
sites.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day and Developer Award, 2026-10-03

sites.name: White Desert
sites.why: Film of two climbers in an ice cave, framed by a huge condensed white word ANTARCTICA (Oswald) over a small italic serif tagline; Experience, Operation, About left, Rates and Enquire right, Watch Film link, consent box. Trip prices (US$16,500 to 115,500) lower on the page.
sites.recognition: Awwwards Site of the Day and Developer Award, 2026-09-11

sites.name: Velaa Private Island
sites.why: Full-screen video of guests with champagne, no headline on the first screen; Menu, Villas, Dining, Activities left, EN and a filled Book now at right, 'Sound on' bottom right. Instrument Sans with thin Canela headlines further down. No prices, no street address.

sites.name: Lingers
sites.why: Photograph of the hotel behind a vine fence under a dark overlay, centred wordmark, menu icon left, phone, gallery, favourites icons and EN at right; no headline or button on the first screen. Cormorant Garamond and Cinzel. Suites priced from EUR 115 per person lower down.

sites.name: Vander Hotel
sites.why: Black strip with a best-price-when-booking-directly line, then a nav with Book now and a Book a room link; centred script line, a large capital sans headline, two lines of copy and an outlined Book a room button, four small room photographs scattered around. Beige (#f4f2f1). No room rates.

sites.name: Tandjung Sari
sites.why: Lobby photograph in dark wood with a side bar (logo, menu icon, WhatsApp) and Book room and Book table buttons top right; a cookie box over the centre on load and no headline. Helvetica with Adobe Caslon Pro for titles further down. No prices or address in the page text.

sites.name: MontRural (Masia Mont Rural)
sites.why: Cream (#f8e8c5) upper half with a split serif headline 'Private Masia among the vineyards of Penedès' (Playfair), two short paragraphs (6 bedrooms, 12 guests), a terrace photograph below, Book now and Check availability pinned bottom right. Prices (790 to 1200 EUR) lower; page said unavailable.

avoid: A hero video with sound or a gate before the visitor can see the headline, the price range or the booking button.
No prices and no statement on how prices are given, so the visitor cannot judge the budget.
Booking on a different brand or domain than the hotel without telling the visitor.
Room cards that are only images, with no size, guests or inclusions.
Cookie banners that hide the booking button on a phone.
A page that shows a sample date in the past or an unavailable notice with no alternative contact.
